metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in Thailand increase in April 2016 compared to April 2001-2010 average?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location). - Dataset: MODIS/061/MOD11A2 (8-day, 1 km LST Day), fallback to MODIS/061/MOD11A1 (daily). - Region: Thailand from USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017 (country_na = "Thailand"). - Time: April 2016 vs April 2001–2010 (inclusive). 2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?). - Apply MODIS LST quality mask using QC_Day: * Bits 0–1 (LST quality) == 0 (good). * Bits 6–7 (LST error) <= 1 (≤2 K error). - Convert LST to Celsius: LST_Day_1km * 0.02 - 273.15. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3). - Check ImageCollection sizes; if 0 (after fallback), output C1. - Count valid pixels after QC. If 0 for either period, output C2. - Validate means are numbers and within plausible range (-50 to 70 C). If invalid, output C3. - Compare April 2016 mean vs 2001–2010 April mean. If higher, A; else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line async function runAnalysis() { try { // Helpers const getInfo = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate(resolve, reject)); // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const region = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Thailand')).geometry(); const scale = 3000; const start2016 = '2016-04-01'; const end2016 = '2016-05-01'; const startBase = '2001-04-01'; const endBase = '2010-05-01'; // 2. Masking function for MODIS LST Day function maskMODISLST(img) { const qc = img.select('QC_Day'); const goodQuality = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); // bits 0-1 == 0 const errBits = qc.rightShift(6).bitwiseAnd(3); // bits 6-7 const errOk = errBits.lte(1); // <= 2K error const mask = goodQuality.and(errOk); const lstC = img.select('LST_Day_1km') .updateMask(mask) .multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15) .rename('LST_C'); return lstC.copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']); } function buildCol(product, s, e) { return ee.ImageCollection(product) .filterDate(s, e) .filterBounds(region) .map(maskMODISLST) .select('LST_C'); } async function getColWithFallback(s, e) { let product = 'MODIS/061/MOD11A2'; let col = buildCol(product, s, e); let size = await getInfo(col.size()); if (!size || size === 0) { product = 'MODIS/061/MOD11A1'; col = buildCol(product, s, e); size = await getInfo(col.size()); } return { col, product, size: size || 0 }; } const totalPx = await getInfo( ee.Image(1).rename('c').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e12 }).get('c') ); // Acquire collections (with fallback) const { col: col2016, product: prod2016, size: size2016 } = await getColWithFallback(start2016, end2016); const { col: colBase, product: prodBase, size: sizeBase } = await getColWithFallback(startBase, endBase); if (size2016 === 0 || sizeBase === 0) { console.log(`2016 Images: ${size2016}, Baseline Images: ${sizeBase}`); console.log('Empty collection for one or both periods after fallback.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing and stats const img2016 = col2016.mean(); const imgBase = colBase.mean(); const dict = ee.Dictionary({ size2016: size2016, sizeBase: sizeBase, prod2016: prod2016, prodBase: prodBase, valid2016: img2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e12 }).get('LST_C'), validBase: imgBase.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e12 }).get('LST_C'), mean2016: img2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e12 }).get('LST_C'), meanBase: imgBase.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e12 }).get('LST_C'), totalPx: totalPx }); const stats = await getInfo(dict); const v2016 = stats.valid2016 || 0; const vBase = stats.validBase || 0; // Handle No Valid Pixels if (v2016 === 0 || vBase === 0) { console.log(`2016 Images: ${stats.size2016}, Baseline Images: ${stats.sizeBase}`); console.log(`Valid px 2016: ${v2016}/${stats.totalPx}, Valid px baseline: ${vBase}/${stats.totalPx}`); console.log('C2'); return; } const m2016 = stats.mean2016; const mBase = stats.meanBase; // Validate computations const invalid = (x) => (x === null || x === undefined || isNaN(x) || x < -50 || x > 70); if (invalid(m2016) || invalid(mBase)) { console.log(`Mean LST check failed. 2016: ${m2016}, Baseline: ${mBase}`); console.log('C3'); return; } const diff = m2016 - mBase; const cov2016 = (v2016 / stats.totalPx) * 100.0; const covBase = (vBase / stats.totalPx) * 100.0; // 4. Evidence (concise) console.log(`Products used => 2016: ${stats.prod2016}, Baseline: ${stats.prodBase}`); console.log(`April 2016 images: ${stats.size2016}`); console.log(`Apr 2001-2010 images: ${stats.sizeBase}`); console.log(`2016 valid px: ${v2016}/${stats.totalPx} (${cov2016.toFixed(1)}%)`); console.log(`Baseline valid px: ${vBase}/${stats.totalPx} (${covBase.toFixed(1)}%)`); console.log(`Mean LST 2016 (C): ${m2016.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`Mean LST 2001-10 Apr (C): ${mBase.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`Diff 2016 - baseline (C): ${diff.toFixed(2)}`); // 5. Final Answer if (diff > 0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
